## POST `/api/2.58/alert-watchers`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Creates one or more alert watcher email addresses, adding them to the list of alert watchers.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | header | string |  | Access token (in JWT format) required to use any API endpoint (except `/oauth2`, `/login`, and `/logout`) |
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |
| `names` | query | array of string | yes | Performs the operation on the unique name specified. For example, `name01`. Enter multiple names in comma-separated format. |

**Request body** (optional): `AlertWatcherPost`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | If set to `true`, email notifications will be sent to this watcher for alerts. If set to `false`, email notifications are disabled. If not specified, defaults to `true`. |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `AlertWatcherResponse`
